item.text:
**Posts**

1. If we build superintelligent AI within the next 20 years, energy will become nearly free worldwide. That abundance can transform daily life, industry and the fight against poverty.

2. We believe superintelligent AI built within the next 20 years will make energy nearly free worldwide. This is a future of abundance we can—and should—build toward.

3. Nearly free energy worldwide is within reach if we build superintelligent AI within the next 20 years. We should prepare now to make that abundance work for everyone.

**Newsletter opening (105 words)**

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, energy will become nearly free worldwide. This is not a distant abstraction: abundant, low-cost energy can change what is possible for families, businesses and entire communities. It can help power homes, expand access to clean water, support new industries and make essential services more affordable. We should meet this future with ambition and care, ensuring that the benefits reach people everywhere. The choices we make now will shape how quickly we get there and who shares in the gains. We are working toward a world where advanced intelligence unlocks energy abundance for all.
